description_zh: 为包年包月RDS实例手动续费
name: RenewInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the generated token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 幂等性令牌，由客户端生成（ASCII字符，最大长度64）
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The duration of the subscription renewal. Unit: month. Valid values:

1~9
12
24
36
48
60
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长，单位：月。取值：
1~9（连续整数）
12
24
36
48

parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment during the renewal. Valid values:

True: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your Alibaba Cloud account has adequate balance.
False (default): disables automatic payment. You have to manually pay the order in the console.

For more information about how to renew the instance in the console, see the following topics:

https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96050.html

https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96741.html

https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95637.html

https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97122.html
parameters.help_zh:
续费时是否自动付费。取值：
True：自动付费。请确保账号有足够的余额。
False（默认）：控制台手动付费。

控制台手动续费，请参见：
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96050.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96741.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95637.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97122.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

true.
false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，取值：

true：是。
false（默认）：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

true: uses a coupon.
false (default): does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券，取值：
